fields.acceptance: release.yml runs actions/attest-build-provenance over dist/*.tar.gz with id-token: write and attestations: write; goreleaser check and the release-snapshot job pass on the PR
fields.statement: The release job publishes a GitHub build-provenance attestation for every archive, so gh attestation verify <archive> --repo dphaener/rhiza succeeds on a downloaded release

The owner cuts v0.1.0 by hand once the release manifest lands (the owner picked 'By hand after A'), so no leaf cuts it and no builder can verify a real attestation. After the owner pushes the v0.1.0 tag, who runs gh attestation verify on one of its archives and records it as Evidence on release-provenance, closing m33-release-channel's 'v0.1.0 is published' promise: the owner, or the orchestrator when it sees the tag?

ops.note: The attestation check moved out of this leaf's acceptance (plan review round 2, f1): it can only run after v0.1.0 is cut by hand
